rom.name: Baseball Stars - Pocket Sports Series (Japan, Europe) (En,Ja).ngp

note: The game's option save does not survive in Beetle NeoPop: its HLE VECT_FLASHERS (block erase) is a no-op except for block 31 of a 2 MiB cart (mednafen/ngp/biosHLE.c @a50d5ac), so the old option sector at 0x2F8000 is never erased and the game reads it back (proof.png shows the defaults EXTRA INNINGS / CALLED ON after the reset). The same file shape loaded from RACE's .ngf works in Beetle.
